title: mailbox_host_loopback_rejected test broken when built with test-utils feature
description: kith-peer/src/lib.rs:1075-1078 has a #[cfg(feature = "test-utils")] block making is_valid_mailbox_host("127.0.0.1") return true. The unit test mailbox_host_loopback_rejected asserts !is_valid_mailbox_host("127.0.0.1") without a #[cfg(not(feature = "test-utils"))] guard. Running cargo test --features test-utils at workspace level fails this test. Fix: add #[cfg(not(feature = "test-utils"))] attribute to mailbox_host_loopback_rejected, or add a companion test for the test-utils path that asserts loopback IS accepted.
